templates.title: Templates
templates.description: How your CVs and letters look. Open a design to change it visually or describe what you want; the one marked Default is used for new documents.
templates.customDefaultHint: Used for new CVs and letters

presets.atlas: Clean and balanced; works for any field
presets.harbor: Tinted side column for skills, languages and links
presets.ledger: Serif, centred and formal: law, finance, public sector
presets.studio: Colour band header, larger photo: creative and product roles
presets.slate: Dense and tidy: fits a long career on one page
presets.nordic: Quiet and airy: no lines, lots of white space
presets.scholar: Garamond with page numbers: academia and research
presets.vertex: Right side column, tags and icons: engineering and tech
presets.meridian: Merriweather titles, centred header: senior and executive
presets.pulse: Warm accent and section icons: modern and friendly
presets.classic: Neutral sans, uppercase headings with a rule
